name: Tower of the Magistrate
description: White-washed tower at the center of Mercadia City housing the seat of the Chief Magistrate.

description_citations.text: "Tower of the Magistrate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Takara (secretly Volrath) petition the Magistrate to drop charges and repair the Weatherlight in exchange for training armies to conquer the Cho-Arrim; Volrath scares the Kyren magistrate and the bargain is accepted.
timeline.quote: the Chief Magistrate accepted Gerrard's bargain

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sisay, Hanna, Orim and Takara-Volrath strike a deal for a stay of execution for Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn in exchange for obtaining the Power Matrix from Saprazzo.
timeline.quote: They obtained a stay of execution and relocation to better quarters for the three prisoners

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath brings the blinded Starke into the audience chamber and cuts his throat, revealing his true form.
timeline.quote: Murdering Starke by cutting his throat, Volrath revealed his true form

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath kills the lead Kyren Griid over unsatisfactory news about the Ramosians and the Uniter.

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Revolution, Cho-Manno, Orim and others attack the tower and Orim kills the Chief Magistrate with a Kyren poison dart.
timeline.quote: Orim killed him using a Kyren poison dart

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The surviving Kyren are deposed and exiled to the mountains, and the people rule the tower.
timeline.quote: The surviving Kyren were deposed and exiled to the mountains of Mercadia

citation.text: "Tower of the Magistrate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
